payload.title: rollbackReadOnlyMutations (src/runner/dispatch/assignment-runner.mjs) has zero callers…
payload.description: rollbackReadOnlyMutations (src/runner/dispatch/assignment-runner.mjs) has zero callers codebase-wide -- a read-only-graded dispatch that writes a real file gets correctly graded status:'failed'/confidence:'failed', but the file itself is never actually removed. Confirmed pre-existing (predates commit 86d0106c), found during group-thinking-plan-loop's P01.1 kernel-cell red-team review. Wire rollbackReadOnlyMutations into executeAssignment's real settlement path in assignment-runner.mjs so a failed read-only-violation run actually cleans up the file it wrote, matching what test/runner/coordination-mutation-unlock.test.mjs's own Tests First #5(a) originally (incorrectly) claimed was already verified.
payload.verify: chưa xác định — P15 bổ sung

payload.title: src/verbs/coordination/run.mjs's operation-step dispatch never forwards a request step's mutation…
payload.description: src/verbs/coordination/run.mjs's operation-step dispatch never forwards a request step's mutation field to dispatchDeclaredOperation (session-engine.mjs), so P01.1's entire mutation-unlock mechanism (mutation:'mutating' on an operation step) has ZERO reachable surface through the real 'fgos coordination run' CLI door today -- every real, correct mutating dispatch through this door is silently graded status:'failed' regardless of the work's actual correctness, since dispatchDeclaredOperation defaults to mutation='read-only' when the field is omitted. Confirmed live 4 separate times during group-thinking-plan-loop's P03.1 R5 proof on a separate host project (real codex-cli commits genuinely landing correctly but graded failed). Fix: thread step.mutation through run.mjs's operation-step branch (~run.mjs:431-455) into the dispatchDeclaredOperation call, with the same rigor (independent review+red-team) this track's own P01.1 kernel cell required, since this re-opens the mutation-unlock surface at the CLI layer.
payload.verify: chưa xác định — P15 bổ sung
